Enter your account email. We’ll send instructions if password recovery is available.
Use a strong, unique password. Your account’s password requirements are checked when you submit.

You’re using a previously signed-in session offline. Account changes need a connection.
Verification is optional. You can verify your email whenever you’re ready.
Verification requested. Check your inbox, open the link, then return here to refresh.
If password recovery is available for this email, you’ll receive instructions. Check your inbox and spam folder.

This is the email you’ll use with your new password. An Apple private relay address also works as your account email.
You’ll confirm your identity with your linked Google account.

You won’t be able to sign in with this method after unlinking. Using it again from the login screen may create a separate account. To reuse it, sign in with your remaining method and link it again here.
Sign-in method linked to your account.
Sign-in method removed. Your remaining method still opens this account.
Installations that have connected to your account. To end access everywhere, use sign out on all devices.
All devices will need to sign in again when they reconnect. Your local audio stays on this device.

Refresh your account to finish registering this device for server processing.

Check the email and password fields, then try again.
Unable to sign in with these details. Try again or use password recovery.
Unable to create this account. Try signing in or use password recovery.
This sign-in method may already belong to an account. Sign in to the account that owns it. Accounts have not been merged.
This password does not meet the account’s security requirements. Use a longer password with uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers and a symbol.
Confirm your identity with a working sign-in method before continuing.
Use the sign-in details for your current account.

Schedule deletion of your account, cloud inputs, vocal results, history and device registrations. Account access ends immediately. You have three months to request recovery; after that, permanent cleanup starts and your media can no longer be recovered. Private account copies on this installation are removed. Original selected files and exported copies stay under your control. Authenticate again to continue.
Schedule account deletion? You will be signed out immediately and have three months to request recovery by signing in again. Permanent cloud cleanup starts after that deadline.
Deletion scheduled. You are signed out. Sign in again within three months if you want to request account recovery.
Create vocals-only audio. Remove music uploads this audio to private cloud storage for processing. Results and history stay in your account until you delete them.
I own this audio or have permission to download and process it.
Download audio from YouTube only when you have permission and the service permits downloading. You will review the downloaded audio separately before any cloud upload.
A deletion request could not be confirmed. Sign in again to retry deletion, or use account deletion help. Your data is not reported as deleted.
Account deletion is scheduled. You can request recovery from this page.
The three-month recovery period has ended and permanent deletion has started.
This account is scheduled for deletion. Send a recovery request to the MusicMute team before the deadline. Your account stays inaccessible until an administrator approves it.
Your high-priority recovery request is awaiting administrator review. This page checks for a decision automatically.
Your recovery request was not approved. The scheduled deletion remains in place.
